sinopsis.es: Sandra es la nueva guardia de seguridad en un centro comercial. En su primer día de trabajo se cruza con un conductor de bus, con quien vive un romance. Sandra confronta su vida íntima y emprende un camino de libertad a través de su propia experiencia de deseo.
sinopsis.en: Sandra is the new security guard at a shopping mall. On her first day, she crosses paths with a bus driver, with whom she has a brief romance. Sandra confronts her intimate life and embarks on a path of freedom through her own experience of desire.
